instruction: Initialize the floorplan for the loaded gcd netlist with a target core utilization of 35%, a core aspect ratio of 1.0 and 5 um of spacing between the core and the die boundary on every side. Then create the routing tracks for all metal layers.
expected_outcome: Die and core defined with ~35% core utilization, a square core, ~5 um core-to-die margins, placement rows, and routing tracks on metal1-metal10.
notes: Worked example of the task / validator / control format. Utilization is measured on the resulting core (logic cell area / core area), so any construction method that achieves it passes.
